verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a first-party Access Reviews product that 'automates and accelerates the access review process' with pre-built content and guided workflows, so the core capability exists. The specific elements of the story are not evidenced: no recurring review cadence, no reviewing access across connected apps, no in-app reviewer sign-off, and no review artifact filed in an evidence library. Missing for 10: periodic/recurring review scheduling, cross-integration access pulls, in-app reviewer sign-off, automatic artifact filing to the evidence library, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, periodic user access reviews run across connected apps in the platform — reviewers sign off in-app and the artifact lands in the evidence library

citations.quote: Vanta's Access Reviews solution automates and accelerates the access review process.
The Access Reviews solution includes pre-built content and intuitive workflows to guide organizations - even those new to access reviews - through the process efficiently.
